chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Yahya al-Halabi, from Harun ibn Kharijah, from Abi Basir, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who performed eight circuits of the House in the obligatory tawaf. He said: He repeats until he completes it properly.

key_terms.ثَمَانِيَةَ: eight, indicating an extra circuit beyond the prescribed amount
key_terms.طَافَ: performed tawaf; circled the Ka'bah ritually
key_terms.يَسْتَتِمَّهُ: he completes it properly and fully

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone performs eight circuits in the obligatory tawaf?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who performs eight circuits in the obligatory tawaf around the Ka'bah instead of the prescribed number. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that he must repeat it until it is completed correctly, showing the importance of precision in the rites of hajj.
